title: Series data (yData, breakdown) must stay unrounded; rounding happens only at display
answers: Why doesn't yData round to decimal places
Metric card total or pie total sums rounded values
Breakdown bucket sums differ from raw sum
body:
y-axis series (`yData` selector in dataVisualizationLogic.ts) and `parseBreakdownSeriesValue` in Components/seriesBreakdownLogic.ts must NOT round to formatting.decimalPlaces.
Display paths (tooltips, axis ticks, value labels, pie labels, metric headline) already round via formatSqlSeriesValue in Components/Charts/sqlLineGraphAdapter.ts.
If series are rounded, metric card total/average/change badge, pie totals and unaggregated breakdown buckets sum rounded values (two 0.49 rows become 0 instead of 0.98).
yData must also return null (or 0 with showNullsAsZero) for unparseable values like 'NaN', not NaN.
Draft PR #105535 moves these parsers into seriesValues.ts; whichever lands second must drop the rounding too.
applies: SQL data visualization series parsing (yData, breakdown series)
says: Chart total doesn't match visible numbers summed
Pie slices add up to incorrect total
Breakdown bucket values misaligned with source data
Metric card total differs from sum of values
Rounding errors accumulate in final result
